data.long_meaning: Rājesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘rāj,’ which means ‘king’ or ‘ruler.’ This name is a symbol of power, authority, and leadership. It is believed that individuals named Rājesh possess the qualities of a great leader and are destined to rule in various aspects of life. The name राजेश carries the meaning “Ruler of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose राजेश usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
